name: Rui wa Tomo o Yobu Fan Disc -Asu no Mukou ni Mieru Kaze-
original_name: るいは智を呼ぶファンディスク ―明日のむこうに視える風―
source:
This fandisc for Akatsuki Work’s 2008 title Ruitomo is comprised of routes for subchars Yenfei, Megumu and Miyawa, as well as a side episode. All the main heroines from the original game will have short stories with H scenes. Ruitomo was a great game about overcoming hardships together and this fandisk will help resolve those hidden truths that remained.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/09/01/september-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这张Akatsuki Work 2008年作品《Ruitomo》的同人光盘由副线角色Yenfei、Megum和Miyawa的路线以及一个插曲组成。原版游戏中的所有主要女主角都会有带有H场景的短篇故事。《Ruitomo》是一款关于共同克服困难的伟大游戏，这个粉丝盘将有助于解决那些仍然隐藏的真相。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/09/01/september-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
